notes.title: Launch Date, Features, and Final Playtest!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Deducto 2 Launches on June 15th! 🚀[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]💲 Only $5 USD[/b][/h2]
After careful consideration, we've set the price for Deducto 2 at an affordable $5. Our goal is to make the game accessible to as many players as possible while still fairly compensating our hardworking team. We hope you're as excited about this as we are!


[h2][b]🚫 No Microtransactions[/b][/h2]
Deducto 2 will not include microtransactions. Instead, players can unlock most in-game cosmetics using DBucks, an in-game currency earned through progression. While we don't plan to add microtransactions, we will offer a post-launch DLC called the "VIP Bundle." This bundle may include exclusive cosmetics, parkour courses, and a community status symbol, among other rewards!


[h2][b]🗺️ Revamped Maps[/b][/h2]
Deducto 2 brings you updated Office & Construction Maps, featuring new tasks, layout changes, and more. We're also excited to introduce an all-new map: Courthouse!


[h2][b]⚖️ The Courthouse[/b][/h2]
Put your friends' testimonies to the test in the exciting new Courthouse map, which offers fresh tasks, a new jail system, and the Judge role.


[h2][b]🧟 Infected Mode Update[/b][/h2]
Initially, we announced an Infected Mode for Deducto 2. However, after further development, we've decided not to include it at launch. Game development often requires changes in direction, and we felt this mode wasn't meeting our expectations. We may revisit the idea in the future, but it's not part of our current plan.


[h2][b]🎯 Final Playtest[/b][/h2]
📅 Mark your calendars for the last playtest before launch, taking place on the weekend of May 26th! 📅 The playtest will feature only the Courthouse map. Your feedback will be invaluable in helping us prepare for launch, so please join the playtest and share your thoughts, feedback, and bug reports.

[b][url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z]Join our community on Discord! 🎉[/url][/b]

notes.title: The Future of Deducto
notes.content:
This update is about the future of Deducto, and what to expect going forward! Please reach out with any questions with a comment on this post, or on our Discord.

Deducto will continue receiving small updates and bug fixes. We won't be releasing any more maps for Deducto 1. I'm proud of how much content we created for Deducto 1, and you can look forward to more coming in the sequel!

[b]We are making a sequel![/b]
We wanted to make sweeping changes that would be too disruptive to put in an update. Changes such as a new parkour system, reworked maps, a new cosmetic system, and a character with different feeling movement. By making a sequel, we can preserve Deducto 1 as a great free-to-play option, and it allows us to spend the needed time to make big changes for a new-and-improved Deducto 2.

[b]Will Deducto 2 cost money?[/b]
Yes, it will cost around $5-$10 USD.

[b]Will all my DLC hats transfer over?[/b]
No, however, there will be exclusive items for those that purchased Deducto 1 DLC. We will also have new cosmetics unlockable through gameplay.


[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2119590/Deducto_2/]Please wishlist![/url] It helps support us and helps the game's visibility on steam!
[/b]

By making a sequel, we can preserve Deducto 1 as a great free-to-play option, and it allows us to spend the needed time to make big changes for a new-and-improved Deducto 2.

Yes, it will cost around $5-$10 USD.

[b]Will all my DLC hats transfer over?[/b]
No, however, there will be exclusive items for those that purchased Deducto 1 DLC. We will also have new cosmetics unlockable through gameplay.

notes.title: Neighborhood Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]Welcome to the Neighborhood![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/35b9a1d900aa3916bf6e1c3e877099b66103d3f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/7c2724648f52a28d8d9fb170deabbc6db1a77ef6.png[/img]
[b]Tired of work?[/b] Now it's the weekend, and it's time to get chores done! In this map, you must water your plants, cut the weeds, and deal with your neighbors. The neighborhood is a lot of fun and has many new features.


[b][h2]Thief Role[/h2][/b]
The thief is a new imposter role that steals money from the neighborhood and uses the money to buy deadly items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/bc7da05e0e1d46ad0184de3ec02361db77256164.png[/img]
[b]Slowing Cake[/b] This item is a useful trap that stuns players that come near it. I think we can all relate to the slowing effect of cake... nam nam nam.

[b]Explosive Propane[/b] This explosive trap has a short arming period, then clear the area! Anyone in it's radius will die when the trap is set off.

[b]Golden Gun[/b] This thief-only weapon fires twice the speed of the security gun. The sound of it firing strikes fear into honest, hardworking neighbors.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/10756561dc3edccb2c364aae2613264c581a0ee9.png[/img]
[b]Neighbor Purchasable Items:[/b] the [b]Energy Drink[/b] and [b]Blue Stapler[/b] are both purchasable by neighbors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/0cc1f091093c5ad4197b09dcb2d805d8ea456eb8.png[/img]

notes.title: What's Next?? [Dev Update]
notes.content:
Hi co-workers!

We have been working very hard on our next big update. I won't be revealing everything yet, but this post will give you guys some idea of what's coming up.

[b]Our next big update will include a new map and a new parkour level[/b]! These are our main two focuses for the update and we can't wait for you to play them. There will also be new items, tasks, and one new role!

I'll reveal more information on everything as it gets closer to release.

[h2]Community Poll[/h2]
Vote for which item you'd like to see added to the game! We will be running a poll on our discord for the next two days. We'd like to do more events like this in the future to get the community more involved with the game's development. [url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z][b]VOTE HERE[/b][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/VFPXZ8Z][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/b97a6dc0c80a28b86292224fee7c6690c626c6bc.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Beta Testing[/h2]
Like previous updates, we will run private beta tests through our discord server. These are invite-only and are meant for our most frequent players that don't mind bugs. We always look for player feedback, and our beta testers are a tremendous help!

[h2]New Cosmetics[/h2]
[b]Wacky Helmets[/b] will be the newest DLC pack coming to Deducto! It will release at the same time as our big update. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065040/Deducto__Wacky_Helmets/][b]WISHLIST NOW[/b][/url]

[h2]Release Date[/h2]
TBD. There's no set date, but I estimate that the update will be released sometime in September.

notes.title: Construction Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]Rebranding[/h2][/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/8f5216db6281d9847a68afd7e9bcd8f0a090ed59.png[/img]

[b]With this update, we are altering the name from Deduction -> Deducto![/b]
The reason is simple - it's about uniqueness and searchability. Our game is hard to find online because "Deduction" is such a commonly used word. When searching for it on youtube, for example, you might get tax deduction content or videos related to any of the other social deduction games.

Naming a social deduction game "Deduction" was kind of like naming an FPS game "Shooter".
The new name will really help us grow and reach more players, I hope you guys like it!


[b][h2]Construction Map[/h2][/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/e8a7f22e3c3768bb84844689bcf68023f6767cdb.png[/img]
[b]Tired of being stuck in the office?[/b] If you are looking for a position where you get to work with your hands - this job site might be the one for you! It features indoor and outdoor spaces, as well as underground pipes that imposters can utilize. This map is also significantly larger with more paths to get around.


[b][h2]Supervisor Role[/h2][/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/54df8e3d0cdb4923fcb04864d9754316e942e039.png[/img]
[b]The supervisors are the only ones that get a vote in this new gamemode![/b] It is their job to keep track of who's doing their tasks and figure out who the killers are. If all the supervisors are killed, a random co-worker will be promoted to take their place!


[b][h2]New Items[/h2][/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/2e3db67424e0d47417843b23bdd9e4b0ad66768c.png[/img]
[b]Nail Gun[/b] This new imposter weapon fires full auto, dealing 25 damage per hit. The sound of it firing strikes fear into the hearts of co-workers, much like the nails that it fires.

[b]Gas Can[/b] This item is a useful tool for co-workers to fill vehicles with gas, while the imposters use it for a different purpose...

[b]Disguise[/b] Imposters have access to this item that can conceal their identity. If they use it too much, it may be obvious who wasn't accounted for during the round.


[b][h2]Female Character[/h2][/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/8667f7a834d4bb733e557176b03a172e7184d63a.png[/img]

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Summary[/b][/h2]
Deduction suffered from lighting inefficiencies which dragged frame rates down, and GPU usage up. This update provides massive improvements on both fronts!


[b]Framerate Comparsion[/b] your mileage may vary, but here are the results of my testing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/33a3debbc31835ed774bf8b765d3a4e06700199a.png[/img]


[b]Lighting Improvements[/b] as a result of optimization, the game can now handle way better lighting!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/f926f1e104381c3196a3adbec814d800ad51041b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/1731a347974b087988d83bb6e20559ae651dae42.png[/img]


[b]New Graphics Settings[/b] Limit FPS is the important one that was previously lacking
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/e9e85c77dd6abe999785c33e0043ff49c6961f79.png[/img]


[b]Why was the GPU usage so high?[/b]
The framerate was uncapped. This meant the GPU was working as hard as possible to hit maximum FPS.
If your computer is powerful enough to hit the refresh rate of your monitor (and VSync is on) your GPU wouldn't max out, so you didn't experience this issue.

[b]What were the optimizations?[/b] 
I changed render pipelines (Unity HDRP to URP). Something that no one would recommend doing just after launching a game, but it was the hotfix we needed. The new render pipeline has better FPS, better lighting, and it can run on more devices. It feels like an absolute relief.

Mirrors were removed for being absolute framerate killers.

Special thanks to my friend Paul for helping with this update! I'm excited about these improvements, I feel it will make for a much smoother experience. More updates coming soon!
Patrick

notes.title: Week One Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Summary[/b][/h2]

[b]Bugs[/b]
I had no idea this game would be so popular and that some players would experience such severe issues. I went in full bug-fixing mode and made a ton of progress since its launch.

[b]Bad Performance[/b]
Performance is something that I'm actively working on. These are the real reasons for bad graphics performance:
[list]
[*] mirrors require a lot of extra rendering
[*] cameras placed in the map require a lot of extra rendering (only while in cams room)
[*] minimap was using a camera (already fixed!)
[*] multiple cameras running at once (already fixed!)
[*] lack of basic optimization (ex: the exterior map seems expensive to render)
[/list]
I will continue working on optimization and adding graphic settings! Sorry for those of you who have experienced issues.

[b]Stats[/b]
Over 25,000 players in the first 4 days. Close to 100 reviews with a "Mostly Positive" score at this time.
This far exceeded my expectations, thank you to everyone that's played!

[h2][b]Community[/b][/h2]

[b]Discord[/b]
Big thanks to everyone that's joined our discord! You've been providing bug reports, suggestions, and finding groups to play with. I appreciate you guys, and if you haven't already, [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV][b]join us[/b][/url]!

[b]Community Highlight[/b]
It has been so awesome watching people play Deduction on Twitch. Show these streamers some love, and please keep making content for us to enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/ced6f51df39f13cc4a20e2157dcf906cc8dc7a06.png[/img]

[b]Community Disappointment[/b]
Without tools like mute and kick, it's hard to deal with toxic players. Adding those features has been a very high priority for me. The ultimate goal is for everyone to have a good experience in the game.

[h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2]

[b]New hallway opens up[/b]
This hallway connects Servers to Cams for quick access around the lower level of the map.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/345e1e873b3e7d4e085e3d2af728232585865bf9.png[/img]


[b]Something new in the parkour area..[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/b74d3b5e635f58bf5a4260155cfc3944b940bbeb.png[/img]

[b]Paid cosmetics coming soon![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/7bdc8d00e41e28f83fe379ae6a2c81df5b093283.png[/img]

[h2]Week One Recap[/h2]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added graphics quality option
[*] Added ability to set volume for individual players
[*] Added to option leave mic always on (for those that don't like push-to-talk)
[*] Added ability for host to kick players from lobby
[*] Added ability for host to ban players from lobby
[*] Opened new hallway on lower level of map
[*] Added a little something for completing the parkour area
[*] Added player marker to map
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Remade minimap to drastically improve game performance
[*] Increased character limit for chat messages
[*] Increased duration of chat messages
[*] Added "Waiting for Host" text to whiteboard in lobby
[*] Added label for men's room & ladies room
[*] Added hint to radio task so players know to look for three radios
[*] Added "catch box" under map to teleport players back to spawn (in case they fall through the map)
[*] Added "Returning to Lobby" UI for smoother transition back to lobby
[*] Changed frequency that lobby list updates. Now it is much easier to join rooms and type in passwords!
[*] Sorted lobbies so public open lobbies display on top, and private lobbies lower down the list
[*] Added option to type in a passcode to join lobby without having to find it on the list
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed players being able to respawn with items in the waiting area
[*] Fixed map displaying the outdated version of the world
[*] Prevent players from joining match as it's counting down to start
[*] Prevent players from attempting to join full lobbies

notes.title: Deduction Launch Info
notes.content:
The launch is just one day away!! Deduction will go live at 10am pst February 10th.
Everyone with the game on their wishlist will release an email from Steam about the release.

Special thanks to my friends that helped me make this game. Couldn't have done it without you guys, and all those playtests we did. I really appreciate you guys.

This game is really important to me, and I look forward to supporting it after launch with new updates and content. I hope players have lots of memorable moments while playing. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV][b]discord[/b][/url] to stay up to date with development, and find players to start up lobbies with.

See you in the game soon!
Patrick

notes.title: 7 DAYS TILL LAUNCH
notes.content:
Deduction is launching next week! I hope a lot of people enjoy the game. I've put so much passion, time, and work into this project, and it's come a long way. Here's a sneak peek at some of the new art that's been added recently.

[h1]New Challenger Approaches![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/a2bc084d6b935ed52b519aa58b2d99d22cff814c.png[/img]

We have a new character model! Office Man loves coffee and asking about your weekend. He also enjoys long meetings and micromanagement.

[h1]New Plants[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/61bb1c28b9f0d61a5725365f544776531b05b9b4.png[/img]
Little touches like these make the environment look much prettier.

More work is being done on things like adding text chat in the game (a feature that's been long planned). 

Patrick

notes.title: Playtest Live!
notes.content:
The playtest is live!! It will be up all weekend. This is early access to the game - PLEASE EXPECT BUGS.
Report bugs on the [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV][b]discord[/b][/url]. Thank you!

If you encounter game-breaking bugs, please restart your game/lobby!
Known issues involve players leaving mid-game,

See you in the game!
Patrick

notes.title: Playtest Annoucement
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce our public playtest will begin on January 21st and end on the 23rd. This will be the first time the game has ever been playable publicly!

There are hundreds of people signed up to play so I'm hoping there will be a lot of games played over the weekend. Please expect some bugs, and report them so they can be fixed right away.

I will be eagerly looking for feedback on our discord server. Please join! [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV]discord[/url]

Signup for the playtest if you haven't already (the button is on our main steam page).

See you in the game!

notes.title: Dev Update #4
notes.content:
Happy October!

[h1]New Release Date[/h1]
There was no way this game would be ready in time for my previously set release date so, I pushed it back to [b]January 10th, 2022[/b]. I think this will leave a good amount of time to polish up the game before release. I'm sorry if anyone is disappointed by the delay, but it will allow the game to be greatly improved for launch.

[h1]Upcoming Playtest[/h1]
Steam has recently added a new playtest feature that Deduction will take advantage of. People will signup to participate over time, then I will hold weekend playtests, and those signed up with get notified via email. Hopefully, we get enough players to fill lobbies and have some fun. I'm looking forward to making changes based on feedback from these playtests that will hopefully really improve the game.
[b]Please sign up for the Playtest back on the main page[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/47faa9989d641234e6a36b55757757b5e5a9213b.png[/img]

[h1]New Background[/h1]
I've been working on a new setting for the office. I hope this one is looking cool, it's still a work in progress but I'm liking the night setting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/0aee2db8b23dfa1622ddf5b0834bbb4f2f4bd9a0.png[/img]
[h1]New & Improved Lighting[/h1]
Still a work in progress. I need to improve performance, but I think it's a huge improvement to the game's look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/18b7acedb18cbbbe166dd7b0870500ebe8e441c1.png[/img]

[h1]One Year of Development[/h1]
This week marks the one-year anniversary of development on Deduction. Here's a throwback to the first week of development!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/0122e782a32474b01f3eb30ea78c4d386e6f54ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/2bcfba3c3c4ec7a87329c96ba87f308ef2252294.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #3
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Thanks for reading this dev update - I'm posting new updates every two weeks.

[h1]Recap[/h1]

My plan was to make all-new character art on the weekend of Sept 12th, but I ended up playing the Age of Empires 4 beta all weekend. It was so dang fun. Also, character art is super hard and I might need to find help to make something I would be proud to have in the game.

This horrifying creation is what resulted from my character art attempt. I might use it as a scary character one day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/e8e16b72e9611b4682dc35e8f1c7867c789fdc0d.png[/img]


Fast forward to this weekend my goal was to overhaul the map art by improving the aesthetics, layout, and adding detail. This went phenomenally well! I accomplished most of the changes I wanted to make, now it's just about polish and adding onto what's there already.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/5888197fd4a44c6277a259428c2a75fd76908686.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/8cea9eb2306649f71cc0269b779349f00331d0ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/054806c5871a6c582af58128287d8dd212bf3162.png[/img]

[h1]Updated Plans[/h1]
The next two weeks will be focused on playtesting. I will spend a little time during the week to fix up gameplay bugs and prepare the game as best I can. Then I'll spend the next two weekends fixing bugs, and maybe making some progress on character art (we'll see).

Big thanks to @Slayer0248 and @BigglesthePlainCake for help with playtesting. You guys are greatly appreciated! And thanks to @Alli for their continued support as always!

Patrick

[b]Please add Deduction to your wishlist[/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.content:
[h2]What's new[/h2]
For the last couple of weeks, I've been focusing on items. I've redone animations, changed sound effects, and added hit impacts for weapons. I also plan on adding a new knife item that can be used for stealth kills![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/f9d99c6c5012933eb858d3ada6904e6b62e2038d.png[/img]

[h2]5 Week Plan[/h2]
This is my schedule for what I'll be working on over the next five weeks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213532/6a60f981a7dce2cf32fb36f1ea8d6d6a2e1412af.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming Playtests[/h2]
Same as before, I am going to need as many playtesters as I can get. Please join the  [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV]discord[/url] and let me know if you are interested! Thank you

Patrick

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.content:
I've set a release date for Deduction! Nov 1st is the date but game dev is a tricky thing - I will adjust the release date if needed. Setting a goal helps me progress, and I'm looking forward to launching this game I started roughly 6 months ago with a friend.

I hope you guys enjoy playing it as much as I have. Please reach out with any questions, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV]discord[/url]. I'll be posting updates there frequently, and would like to hear feedback from everyone.

Also, playtests will be held through the [url=https://discord.gg/DFrn4XV]discord[/url], so please join if you'd like to participate, and reach out to me. More info coming soon!

Patrick
